name: @matatbread/matbot-tool-router
description: Routes the model to the tools it needs from a large library: a ToolPresenter that presents a tool_search entry point and a de-duped noun catalogue to prime discovery. Currently in instrument mode (present-only-tool_search, returns all, logs request/query/pick to JSONL) so a filter can be tuned offline against the model's own choices; the pass-through presenter is the scaffold the real relevance filter drops into.
